name: Possessed Cat
body:
POSSESSED CAT
CR 1/3

XP 100
CE Tiny animal
Init +2; low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 size)
hp 3 (1d8 – 1)
Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +4 (1d2-4), bite +4 (1d3-4)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 3, Dex 15, Con 8, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 7
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 16 (+10 vs. trip)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +6, Perception +5, Stealth +14
Languages —
SQ low-light vision, scent

ABOUT

At first glance, this creature appears to be an ordinary domestic feline prowling dusty manor hallways. However, upon closer inspection, its pupils burn with unnatural, chaotic intelligence, its claws extend like steel needles, and its fur bristles with dark spiritual malice.

Possessed by lingering spectral energies, a Possessed Cat acts as a sinister scout and ambush predator. By day, it feigns affection and purrs softly around caretakers to lower suspicion; by night, it stalks living travelers in their bedchambers, leaping for throats from atop wardrobes and drawing first blood before fleeing into narrow wall passages.
